SELECT public.listmonk_record_external_unsubscribe(
  '{{ String($json.email || "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  NULLIF('{{ $json.id || "" }}', '')::integer,
  NULLIF('{{ $json.uuid || "" }}', '')::uuid,
  'listmonk_unsubscribe_poll',
  '{{ JSON.stringify($json).replace(/'/g, "''") }}'::jsonb
) AS updated_count;

SELECT
  x.contact_id::text AS contact_id,
  x.contact_type,
  x.email_normalized,
  COALESCE(x.mailing_subscription_status, '') AS mailing_subscription_status,
  x.mailing_unsubscribed_at,
  x.mailing_unsubscribe_source,
  x.listmonk_subscriber_id,
  x.listmonk_subscriber_uuid::text AS listmonk_subscriber_uuid
FROM (
  SELECT
    me.member_email_id AS contact_id,
    'member_email'::text AS contact_type,
    me.email_normalized,
    me.mailing_subscription_status,
    me.mailing_unsubscribed_at,
    me.mailing_unsubscribe_source,
    me.listmonk_subscriber_id,
    me.listmonk_subscriber_uuid,
    me.updated_at
  FROM public.member_emails me
  WHERE me.status = 'active'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    ce.contributor_email_id AS contact_id,
    'contributor_email'::text AS contact_type,
    ce.email_normalized,
    ce.mailing_subscription_status,
    ce.mailing_unsubscribed_at,
    ce.mailing_unsubscribe_source,
    ce.listmonk_subscriber_id,
    ce.listmonk_subscriber_uuid,
    ce.updated_at
  FROM public.contributor_emails ce
  WHERE ce.status = 'active'
) x
WHERE
  lower(x.email_normalized) = lower('{{ String($json.email || "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}')
  OR x.listmonk_subscriber_id = NULLIF('{{ $json.id || "" }}', '')::integer
  OR x.listmonk_subscriber_uuid = NULLIF('{{ $json.uuid || "" }}', '')::uuid
ORDER BY
  CASE
    WHEN x.listmonk_subscriber_id = NULLIF('{{ $json.id || "" }}', '')::integer THEN 0
    WHEN x.listmonk_subscriber_uuid = NULLIF('{{ $json.uuid || "" }}', '')::uuid THEN 1
    ELSE 2
  END,
  x.updated_at DESC
LIMIT 1;
